profile.summary: Kalpataru Limited, through its subsidiaries, operates as a real estate development company in India. It engages in the real estate development, leasing, renting business; development lifecycle; and residential, comprising premium high-rise developments, integrated townships, and redevelopment projects in the Mumbai metropolitan region and Pune. The company was formerly known as Kalpataru Homes Lim
